description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: Obadiah announces that Edom, proud in its mountain strongholds, will be brought down for its violence against its brother Jacob on the day of Jerusalem's disaster. The day of God is near for all nations, and Mount Zion will be holy and the kingdom will be God's.
1.es: Abdías anuncia que Edom, orgulloso en sus fortalezas de los montes, será derribado por su violencia contra su hermano Jacob el día del desastre de Jerusalén. El día de Dios está cerca para todas las naciones, el monte Sion será santo y el reino será de Dios.
1.fr: Abdias annonce qu’Édom, fier de ses forteresses dans les montagnes, sera abaissé à cause de sa violence contre son frère Jacob au jour du désastre de Jérusalem. Le jour de Dieu est proche pour toutes les nations ; le mont Sion sera saint, et le règne appartiendra à Dieu.
1.pt: Obadias anuncia que Edom, orgulhoso das suas fortalezas nos montes, será derrubado por causa da sua violência contra o seu irmão Jacó no dia do desastre de Jerusalém. O dia de Deus está perto para todas as nações, o monte Sião será santo e o reino pertencerá a Deus.
